narrator.name: George
narrator.why: Tutorial-choir is paced and atmospheric — domestic-kitchen-with-alien-horizon. The narrator wants a warm unhurried storyteller who can sell sensory description (vines bioluminescing, cursor blinking, copper pans) without slipping into clinical mode. George reads cozy. Same voice that worked for Maillard.

lor.name: Matilda
lor.why: Lor's lines are dry-funny and didactic — she's the docs-reader. Matilda's 'knowledgeable upbeat American female' lands the technical precision without performing severity. The dryness reads in the prose; the voice should be warm-confident, not arch.

vex.name: Chris
vex.why: Vex is the chaotic enthusiast — animated grin, talks with his hands, half-formed declarations. Chris's 'charming down-to-earth American male' captures the easy warmth and the ready laugh. Same voice that worked for Theo in Maillard.
